item.title: Glucosamine linked to faster Alzheimer’s progression
item.description:
A health-record analysis suggests glucosamine use is associated with a 25% higher risk of cognitive impairment progressing to dementia. Lab studies indicate the supplement may intensify abnormal sugar-tagging in the brain, though clinical trials are required to confirm causality.

item.title: Blood thinners reduce stroke risk in atrial fibrillation patients
item.description:
The SINGLE-AF trial found that direct oral anticoagulants cut the risk of serious clinical events by 69% in intermediate-risk patients. This benefit was driven primarily by a reduction in ischemic strokes without increasing major bleeding.
